newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian hard-left to vote against Albania force.
newsitem.headline: Italian hard-left to vote against Albania force.

text.p: The hard-left Communist Refoundation party confirmed on Friday that it would vote 'no' when plans for Italian forces to lead a multinational security force to Albania are put to parliament next week.
"Our opposition to military intervention in Albania remains," party leader Fausto Bertinotti told a news conference.
Asked whether the party would abstain on a vote, he said: "We have decided...to vote against."
Refoundation's lower house deputies ensure Prime Minister Romano Prodi's parliamentary majority though the party is not part of his government.
Since the opposition centre-right has said it will back the force, the plan is not in danger but Refoundation's stance has led to considerable tension with Prodi's coalition.
The proposal to deploy up to 2,500 Italian troops with the force will be put to the vote in the Senate (upper house) on Tuesday and the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) on Wednesday.
